s1.quote: Maracaibo Wall … for advanced divers only, since it is one of the deepest sites on the island, with the wall starting from 27m … is exposed to extreme currents, big swells and topside surfing … spotted eagle rays, turtles and schools of hammerhead sharks

s2.quote: Maracaibo Reef … Reaches depths of 80+ feet (24+ meters) … Known for its strong currents and challenging conditions … Advanced divers only

hazards.text: Extreme currents, big swells and surf

summary.text: One of Cozumel's deepest, most exposed sites at the island's south end, with a wall starting near 27 m. Strong currents and swell make it advanced-only; eagle rays, turtles and sharks reward the effort.

s1.quote: Dos Ojos is perfect for cenote diving from Tulum. … This section is shallow with huge rooms, has no current, and is ideal for all levels of certified divers. … This area requires great buoyancy control because of the sediment on the bottom.

hazards.text: Silty bottom in Baticueva needs buoyancy control

s1.quote: Cenote El Pit is just that – a big, deep hole. Divers will descend down the pit and pass thousands of years old dead trees and eventually find a spooky cloud of hydrogen sulfate around 30 meters.

Cenote Chikin Ha This is a popular area for snorkelers, cavern divers, and students working on their full cave certification. Here there are two separate cavern lines for divers … This cenote also has a halocline that divers will pass through.

highlights.text: Two cavern lines past rock formations

s1.quote: Cenote El Jardin del Eden is south of Playa del Carmen and has a large, open pool that leads to the cavern. The pool is popular for snorkeling and swimming. … a variety of marine life, including Mayan Gobies.

access.value: Large open pool south of Playa del Carmen, shared with snorkelers

s1.quote: Cenote Car Wash is located on the road from Tulum to Coba. It has a large, beautiful, open area that often has lily pads floating on it. … Cenote Car Wash is a popular cave with local divers who enter a cave called the Room of Tears.

Dreamgate is located deep down a dirt road in the jungle and is a great cavern for rock formations. There are lots of incredible stalactites and rock formations and divers must have great buoyancy to navigate in tight spaces

access.value: Reached by a dirt road through the jungle

highlights.text: Stalactites and tree roots to the water

s1.quote: Cenote Nicte-Ha … The dive is shallow, with the maximum depth being around 8 meters, but this dive is only for divers with experience in cenotes because there is some current and tight maneuvering around formations.

highlights.text: Lily pad garden at the surface

s1.quote: Cenote Taak-Bi Ha This cenote is part of the Sac Actun system and is newly opened for cavern diving. This dive is for advanced divers only because of the fragile stalactites and stalagmites in the area. Divers here will descend down a narrow staircase into a dry cenote, where the tanks will be lowered down.

access.value: Narrow staircase into a dry cenote; tanks lowered

highlights.text: Dense rock formations, good for photography
